Ever wonder how inventory alerts actually work? Let me pull back the curtain a little.

When you set up inventory alerts through Dream AI Journey, you connect your point-of-sale or inventory system to our automation. You tell it the rules: "When Product X drops below 10 units, alert me." Or "When I've sold more than 50 of this item in a week, flag it."

From there, the system watches your stock levels in real time — automatically. No spreadsheet. No end-of-day count. No Monday morning surprise.

When a threshold is hit, you get a notification. Text, email, whatever works for you. You can even set it up so a reorder request gets drafted or sent automatically to your supplier.

The whole thing runs quietly in the background while you're serving customers, filling orders, and actually running your business. You only hear from it when something needs your attention.

No more selling something you don't have. No more emergency restocking panic. Just calm, quiet awareness of what's happening with your inventory — without having to constantly check.
